description: This Java class implements the AccountTransfersReadPlatformService interface and handles operations related to account transfer data retrieval, including templates, pagination, specific transfer fetches, and transaction amount calculations within the FinAI-REACT project.

classes.name: AccountTransfersReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing account transfer data retrieval operations, including templates, list fetching, and specific transfer details.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Generates a transfer template with pre-filled data based on provided office, client, account, and account type identifiers.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of account transfer data based on search parameters and optional account detail filter.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific account transfer record by its ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIds
methods.description: Returns a collection of transaction IDs associated with interest transfers for a given savings account.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIdsWithPivotDate
methods.description: Returns transaction IDs associated with interest transfers for a specified account from a certain pivot date onwards.

methods.name: isAccountTransfer
methods.description: Determines if a transaction ID corresponds to an account transfer for a specific account type (loan or savings).

methods.name: retrieveByStandingInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves paginated account transfer data associated with a specific standing instruction ID.

methods.name: retrieveRefundByTransferTemplate
methods.description: Generates a transfer template specifically for refund transfers, similar to retrieveTemplate but with specific adjustment for advances.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount transferred on a specified date for an account, considering whether it is a loan or savings account.
